title: ROM: Real-time Overthinking Mitigation via Streaming Detection and Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2603.22016v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often suffer from overthinking, continuing with redundant verification and repeated attempts even after reaching a correct solution. This wastes computation and can overturn an initially correct answer. We show that the transition from productive to redundant reasoning is decodable from late-layer hidden states. These representations separate the two phases around first-correct-solution boundaries beyond what position and lexical controls explain, and distinguish correct from incorrect solution endings. Building on this finding, we propose ROM (Real-time Overthinking Mitigation), which uses a lightweight streaming detector (0.07--0.25\% of backbone parameters) to monitor a frozen LRM and intervene at well-formed reasoning boundaries without answer extraction or probe decoding. Counterfactual Self-Correction (CSC) augments detector training with wrong$\rightarrow$correct trajectories to preserve use

translated_title: ROM：基于流式检测与干预的实时过度思考缓解
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）常常受到“过度思考”问题的困扰：即使在得出正确答案后，模型仍会继续进行冗余的验证和重复尝试。这不仅浪费计算资源，还可能推翻原本正确的答案。我们证明了从高效推理到冗余推理的转变是可以从模型深层（late-layer）隐层状态中被解码出来的。这些表征能够在“首个正确解”边界附近将两个阶段区分开，其区分能力超出了位置和词汇控制变量所能解释的范围，并且能够区分正确与错误的解结尾。基于这一发现，我们提出了ROM（Real-time Overthinking Mitigation，实时过度思考缓解），它使用一个轻量级的流式检测器（仅占主干模型参数的0.07%–0.25%）来监控冻结的LRM，并在格式良好的推理边界处进行干预，无需答案提取或探针解码。反事实自我纠正（Counterfactual Self-Correction, CSC）通过错误→正确的轨迹来增强检测器的训练，以保留有用的（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文发现模型从高效推理转入冗余推理的转变可以从深层隐层状态中解码，据此提出ROM框架，用仅占主干参数0.07%–0.25%的轻量流式检测器实时监控冻结的大型推理模型并在推理边界处干预，从而缓解过度思考、节省计算并避免正确答案被推翻。
en_tdlr: ROM shows that the transition from productive to redundant reasoning is decodable from late-layer hidden states, and uses a lightweight streaming detector (0.07–0.25% of backbone parameters) to monitor frozen LRMs and intervene at well-formed reasoning boundaries in real time, mitigating overthinking, saving computation, and preventing correct answers from being overturned.
